headings.text: Every short is reframed by a person, not a crop box. Facecam where the reaction is, gameplay where the play is.
Captions are timed word by word and set in your channel's type.
Do you watch the whole VOD?
Can the captions match my brand?

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "THE FACE STAYS IN FRAME" → 3 lines (5 words, 129.6px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 2 picture(s) on the page (2 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 151 characters per line.
The sheet dealt Chivo and Chivo, but the page renders Archivo, Newsreader.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "HE DID NOT SEE THAT COMING" → 3 lines (6 words, 26.6px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Three options, one final" above "DAILY"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "ONE HP LEFT" (screen 3, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "STREAM" (screen 3, 15% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 3 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "he did", "not", "see that coming"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
